desc: Parse K, S, T from stdin and check the immediate condition abs(len(S)-len(T)) > K → print "No".
Decide the algorithm: banded DP (Ukkonen's) because K ≤ 20 and strings up to 5e5.
Implement the banded DP with two arrays of size 2K+1 (previous and current column), index = d + K.
For each column j from 1 to m, compute valid d range: d_min = max(-j, -K), d_max = min(K, n - j) (ensuring 0 ≤ i ≤ n).
Compute cur[idx] = min(prev_up + 1, prev_down + 1, prev_diag + cost) where cost = 0 if S[i-1]==T[j-1] else 1, using INF for out-of-bound prev entries.
Early termination: if min(cur) > K, print "No" and exit.
After loop, retrieve answer at d = n - m (index = n - m + K); if ≤ K print "Yes" else "No".
Verify on sample inputs: 3/abc/awtf → Yes, 2/abc/awtf → No, 17/twothousandtwentyfour/happynewyear → Yes.
